summary: This code defines a function that greets someone by name, defaulting to 'World' if no name is provided. When called without arguments, it outputs 'Hello World!'

explanations.3: The function parameter $firstname has a type hint (string) and a default value of empty string, meaning you can call the function with or without providing a name.
explanations.5: This uses a ternary operator (the ? :) to check if firstname is empty—if it is, use 'World!', otherwise use whatever name was passed in.
